data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2024 the Syndicate had gross claims outstanding of $600.4m which increased to $1,009.6m at 31 December 2024. The year-end strengthening of gross reserves reflects a combination of current-year large losses (including hurricanes), the inclusion of a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) from another syndicate, and significant exposures and reserve strengthening for the Russia-Ukraine conflict; the report does not provide a single explicit aggregate prior-year gross movement figure and the claims development table is impacted by an RITC, so a reliable aggregate prior-year movement figure could not be determined from the disclosed notes.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year gross reserve movement not explicitly stated in a single 'movement in prior years' gross figure. The claims development triangle is present but is distorted by an RITC (Syndicate 3268) and so is unreliable as a sole source for aggregate prior-year development; for that reason prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null. All monetary values were disclosed in the report in $'000 and have been converted to millions. Some development-triangle intermediate cells had parsing ambiguity; triangle rows supplied as parsed but may contain nulls for inapplicable development periods.
